text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Whoa!? Somehow, power is surging up from 
deep inside me...!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Could this... be a reward for sticking to 
my My Rules!?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Goddesses Three! With this, 
I'll go prove myself even more!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: The true strength of a Mile Queen!
